name: Infected Blood snares enemies taking the Bloodmage's periodic damage (#1258)
contract: Infected Blood 805035's single effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) on Infection 800983, a native aura 33 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED with BasePoints -31, TargetA 6 (enemy) and effect mechanic 11 (snare). Spell.dbc gives 805035 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs generated no entry and the aura was inert. The tooltip is 'Periodic damage dealt now reduces the enemy's movement speed by $800983s1%' at ProcChance 100, so the very first Crimson Tide tick must apply the snare to the unit taking it. Crimson Tide is cast as rank 504134, the rank a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h. Its single effect is aura 3 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE with Amplitude 3000, DurationIndex 8 (15 s), so one cast on the single dummy produces five PROC_FLAG_DONE_PERIODIC events and the first one must already snare it. Nothing here depends on a proc roll: the record's own ProcChance is 100. Infection's effect 0 is BasePoints -31 + DieSides 1 = -30% and SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED scales the unit's run-speed rate, which is not 1.0 for a creature: creature_template entry 36 (Harvest Golem) carries speed_run 1.14286, so a fully applied snare gives 1.14286 * 0.7 = 0.8000020384788513. The speed assertion therefore divides by a pre-snare snapshot of the same metric instead of assuming a base of 1.0.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No snare before the damage over time starts
DISCRIMINATING: the first periodic tick applies Infection
And the snare is really slowing the target by 30% of its own base rate
